purpose: Record the ordered projection pipeline from the Core Expression to a candidate RT witness and its comparison to an already-governed RT expression.

non_claims: Does not assert all RTs arise from the same projection.
Does not assert identity between the Core Expression and the governed RT witness.

ordered_pipeline.reading: A provisional generative label is introduced for the purpose of projection typing only.
The simplest governed basin/projection domain from the existing witness family is reused.
The projection is typed by domain, scale, and admissibility before any candidate output is formed.
The projection yields a candidate projected expression only, not a universal identification.
Closure is checked against the governing RT condition without changing RT_core.
The candidate projection is compared to the already-governed RT witness from the operational Patch 046 example.

trace_result.reading: The ordered pipeline demonstrates a bounded projection surface from the Core Expression into an existing RT witness, but it does not promote the projection to theorem status.

forbidden_inferences: The projection trace does not prove that all RTs are projections.
The projection trace does not prove projection uniqueness.
The projection trace does not prove projection invertibility.
The projection trace does not modify RT_core.
The projection trace does not collapse the Core Expression into the governed RT witness.
